description: This header file provides utility functions for file content reading, property extraction, file existence checks, pattern-based recursive file search, and string expansion with variable substitution. It is part of the Utils namespace and includes functions like readPropertyFromFile, readFileContent, isRegularFile, searchFilesRec, searchFiles, and ExpandPropertiesInString.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads the value of a specified property from a file, supporting recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path points to a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching a pattern within directories, with support for exclusions and limiting results to 10 matches.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive file search given a starting path, depth constraints, and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables in a string by replacing '$' prefixed tokens with their corresponding property values from a specified property file.
